verdict.rationale: The FAQ documents data retention controls covering learnings and review context, plus a separately controllable model-output logging setting. Opting out of all data retention is only available on self-hosted Enterprise, and the no-training commitment adds some privacy assurance. missing for 10: explicit data deletion/purge controls, full retention opt-out on the cloud tier, detailed docs on retention periods and scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
